function.name: entropy_change_calculate
function.description: Calculate the change in entropy for a mass of a specific substance under set initial and final conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which the change in entropy is calculated.

mass.description: The mass of the substance in kg.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

pressure.description: The pressure the substance is under in atmospheres.

Entropy change ΔS = ∫ dQ_rev/T. For irreversible heating, but we can approximate reversible path: melting at 0°C, heating water, boiling at 100°C. Use standard enthalpy of fusion ΔH_fus = 333 kJ/kg, latent heat of vaporization ΔH_vap = 2257 kJ/kg. Specific heat capacities: c_ice ~2.09 kJ/(kg·K) up to 0°C? Actually we start at 0°C ice, no heating needed. Then melt: ΔS_melt = ΔH_fus / T_melt = 333000 J/kg / 273.15 K ≈ 1219 J/(kg·K). Next heating water from 0°C to 100°C: ΔS_heat_water = m * c_water * ln(T_final/T_initial). c_water ~4184 J/(kg·K). So ΔS_heat = 1*4184*ln(373.15/273.15)=4184*ln(1.366)=4184*0.312=1305 J/(kg·K). Next boiling at 100°C: ΔS_vaporize = ΔH_vap / T_boil = 2257000 J/kg / 373.15 K ≈ 6050 J/(kg·K). Sum: 1219+1305+6050=8574 J/(kg·K). That's about 8574 J/K. But the question asks "焦耳/開氏度" which is J/K. So answer ~8574 J/K.

But check units: They ask "焦耳/開氏度" meaning J/K. So answer ~8574 J/K.
